policy.name: Andhra Pradesh MSME & Entrepreneur Development Policy 4.0 (2024-29) - 'One Entrepreneur, One Family by 2030'
policy.order_no: G.O.Ms.No.69, Industries & Commerce (Programme-I) Department, dated 26-10-2024; amended by G.O.Ms.No.22 dated 17-02-2025 (eligibility and capital subsidy paras, enhanced incentives for SC/ST/women/BC/minority)

schemes.name: Investment (capital) subsidy - General category
schemes.clause: G.O.Ms.No.22, I&C (Programme-I) Dept, 17-02-2025, para 5(ii) (substituting MEDP 4.0 para 6.3)
schemes.notes: Official text: General category 25% of FCI, cap micro Rs 25 lakh (2 annual instalments), small Rs 1.5 crore (3), medium Rs 7 crore (4), on CoD/first invoice. 'The subsidy is applicable to only new enterprises.'

schemes.name: Investment subsidy - Special category (Women/SC/ST/BC/Minority/specially-abled)
schemes.clause: G.O.Ms.No.22, I&C (Programme-I) Dept, 17-02-2025, para 5(ii) (substituting MEDP 4.0 para 6.3)
schemes.notes: Official text: Special Category 45% of FCI (cap Rs 45 lakh) micro, 45% (Rs 4.5 crore) small, 35% (Rs 7 crore) medium. Special Category = enterprises wholly owned by women/BC/SC/ST/minority/specially-abled/transgender entrepreneurs domiciled in AP. SC/ST transport-service units have separate caps (not modelled: services). New enterprises only.

schemes.name: Net SGST reimbursement
schemes.clause: G.O.Ms.No.22, I&C (Programme-I) Dept, 17-02-2025, para 5(v) (substituting MEDP 4.0 para 6.6)
schemes.notes: Official text: 100% net SGST for 5 years, annual cap 5% of annual turnover; total SGST incentive shall not exceed 100% of FCI (the ceiling modelled here).

schemes.name: Power cost reimbursement
schemes.clause: G.O.Ms.No.22, I&C (Programme-I) Dept, 17-02-2025, para 5(iv) (substituting MEDP 4.0 para 6.5)
schemes.notes: Official text: General category Rs 1/unit for 5 years from DCP, annual cap micro Rs 1 lakh, small Rs 5 lakh, medium Rs 15 lakh. Special Category Rs 1.5/unit (micro, small) and Rs 1/unit (medium), same caps.

schemes.name: Power cost reimbursement - Special category
schemes.clause: G.O.Ms.No.22, I&C (Programme-I) Dept, 17-02-2025, para 5(iv) (substituting MEDP 4.0 para 6.5)
schemes.notes: Official text: Special Category Rs 1.5/unit (micro, small), Rs 1/unit (medium) for 5 years from DCP, annual caps Rs 1 lakh / 5 lakh / 15 lakh.

schemes.name: Quality certification cost support (top-up to GoI schemes)
schemes.clause: MSME&EDP 4.0 - Quality certification (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: SECONDARY ONLY: ICAI MSME & Startup Committee handbook 'Andhra Pradesh State MSME Policy' (startup.icai.org, 2026) and KIP Financial summary; official G.O. could not be downloaded (apmsmeone.ap.gov.in unreachable). ICAI: 100% reimbursement of certification charges incl. consultancy, as top-up over GoI support (balance after central assistance); cap not given in summary.

schemes.name: Technology upgradation subsidy (existing units modernisation)
schemes.clause: G.O.Ms.No.22, I&C (Programme-I) Dept, 17-02-2025, para 5(iii) (substituting MEDP 4.0 para 6.4)
schemes.notes: Official text: Technology Upgradation, General category 20% of FCI, cap micro Rs 20 lakh, small Rs 2 crore, medium Rs 5 crore. 'Applicable to only expansion/diversification units.'

schemes.name: Technology upgradation subsidy - Special category (Women/SC/ST/BC/Minority/specially-abled/transgender)
schemes.clause: G.O.Ms.No.22, I&C (Programme-I) Dept, 17-02-2025, para 5(iii) (substituting MEDP 4.0 para 6.4)
schemes.notes: Official text: Special Category 40% of FCI (cap Rs 40 lakh) micro, 40% (Rs 4 crore) small, 30% (Rs 5 crore) medium. Expansion/diversification units only.

other_benefits: Stamp duty & transfer duty: 100% reimbursement on purchase/lease of industrial land and buildings (secondary).
Land cost rebate: SC/ST micro & small, 75% up to Rs 25 lakh in APIIC parks, new units only (secondary).
Business Development Credits for medium enterprises: 2% of growth in turnover for 5 years (secondary).
Export: 1% of export turnover for 3 years (secondary).
No interest subsidy for MSMEs found in summaries (8% interest subsidy is under AP Innovation & Startup Policy 4.0). No electricity duty exemption found.
unverifiable: Verified against G.O.Ms.No.22 (17-02-2025), which re-states paras 6.3-6.6 of MEDP 4.0 in full (official copy on apiic.in, supplied by the client). Policy period 2024-29 from G.O.Ms.No.69.
Quality certification top-up comes from the base G.O.Ms.No.69, which is still not downloadable here; it stays unverified.
SC/ST transport-service caps and the SC/ST 75% land-cost rebate (para 6.11) are not modelled: services and land are outside what the app reads from invoices.
